Nikodemo kɔsra Yesu
1 # Yoh 7.50; 19.39 Na onipa bi firi Farisifoɔ mu wɔ hɔ a ne din de Nikodemo a ɔyɛ Yudafoɔ panin bi; 2ɔno na ɔbaa Yesu nkyɛn anadwo, na ɔbɛsee no sɛ: Rabi, yɛnim sɛ wofiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn na aba sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni; na obi ntumi nyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a woyɛ yi, gye sɛ Onyankopɔn ka ne ho. 3#1 Pe 1.23 Yesu bua see no sɛ: Mereka akyerɛ wo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Wɔanwo obi foforɔ a, ɔrentumi nhunu Nyankopɔn ahennie no. 4Nikodemo see no sɛ: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na onipa a wanyini no, wɔbɛtumi awo no? Ɔbɛtumi akɔ ne na yam bio na wɔawo no anaa? 5#Hes 36.25-27; Efe 5.26; Tito 3.5 Yesu buaa sɛ: Mereka no nokorɛ mu pefee akyerɛ wo sɛ: Wɔamfiri nsuo ne honhom mu anwo obi a, ɔrentumi nhyɛne Nyankopɔn ahennie mu. 6#Yoh 1.13; Gye 5.3; Dwom 51.5 Deɛ wɔfiri ɔhonam mu awo no no yɛ ɔhonam; na deɛ wɔfiri Honhom mu awo no no yɛ honhom. 7Mma no nnyɛ wo nwanwa sɛ meka mekyerɛɛ wo sɛ: Ɛtwa sɛ wɔwo mo foforɔ. 8Mframa bɔ kɔ faako a ɛpɛ, na wote ne nka, na wonnim faako a ɛfire ne faako a ɛrekorɔ. Saa ara nso na obiara a wɔawo no Honhom mu no teɛ.
9Nikodemo bua see no sɛ: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yeinom ayɛ hɔ? 10Yesu bua see no sɛ: Woyɛ Israel kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ na wonnim yeinom? 11#Yoh 7.16; 8.26; 8.28 Mereka akyerɛ wo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Deɛ yɛnim na yɛka, na deɛ yɛahunu na yɛdi ho adanseɛ; nanso monnye yɛn adanseɛ no. 12Sɛ maka mo fam asɛm na monnye nni a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na sɛ meka mo ɔsoro nsɛm a, mobɛgye adie? 13#Efe 4.9 Na obi mforo nkɔɔ ɔsoro, gye deɛ ɔfiri ɔsoro sianeeɛ no, Onipa Ba a ɔwɔ ɔsoro no. 14#Num 21.8-9 Na sɛdeɛ Mose maa ɔwɔ no so wɔ ɛserɛ soɔ no, saa ara na ɛtwa sɛ wɔma Onipa Ba no soɔ, 15na obiara a ɔgye no die no anya daa nkwa. 16#Rom 5.8; 8.32; 1 Yoh 4.9 Na sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn dɔɔ wiase nie, sɛ ɔde ne Ba a ɔwoo no korɔ no maeɛ, na obiara a ɔgye no die no anyera, na wanya daa nkwa. 17#Yoh 12.47 Na Onyankopɔn ansoma Ɔba no amma wiase sɛ ɔmmɛbu wiase atɛn, na mmom sɛ wɔmfa ne so nnye wiase. 18#Yoh 3.36; 5.24 Deɛ ɔgye no die no, wɔmmu no atɛn; na deɛ ɔnnye nnie no, wɔabu no atɛn dada sɛ wannye Nyankopɔn ba korɔ no din no annie. 19#Yoh 1.5; 1.9-11 Na yei mmom ne atemmuo no, sɛ hann no aba wiase na nnipa dɔ esum sene hann no; ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nnwuma yɛ bɔne. 20#Efe 5.13 Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no tane hann no, na ɔmma hann no ho, na wɔammu no ne nnwuma ho atɛn. 21Na deɛ ɔyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ no ba hann no ho sɛ ne nnwuma mmɛda adi, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛɛ no Nyankopɔn mu.
Yohane adansedie foforɔ
22 # Yoh 4.1-2 Yeinom akyiri no, Yesu ne n’asuafoɔ no baa Yudea asase so; na ɔne wɔn tenaa hɔ, na ɔbɔɔ asu. 23Na Yohane nso rebɔ asu wɔ Ainon a ɛbɛn Salim, ɛfiri sɛ asuasu pii wɔ hɔ, na wɔbaa hɔ ma wɔbɔɔ wɔn asu. 24#Mat 14.3 Na wɔnnya mfaa Yohane ntoo afiase. 25Ɛnna ahodwira ho akyinnyegyeɛ bi sɔree Yohane asuafoɔ ne Yudafoɔ ntam. 26#Yoh 1.26-34 Na wɔbaa Yohane nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Rabi, deɛ ɔbaa wo nkyɛn Yordan agya nohoa a wodii ne ho adanseɛ no, hwɛ, ɔno nso rebɔ asu, na nnipa nyinaa rekɔ ne nkyɛn. 27#Heb 5.4 Yohane bua kaa sɛ: Onipa ntumi nnya biribi, gye sɛ wɔde firi soro ama no ansa. 28#Yoh 1.20; 1.23; 1.27 Mo ara modi me adanseɛ sɛ mekaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mene Kristo no, na wɔsomaa me dii n’anim. 29#Mat 22.2 Deɛ ayeforɔ wɔ no ne ayeforɔkunu; na ayeforɔkunu adamfo a ɔgyina hɔ na ɔtie no deɛ, ɛgyeɛ na n’ani gyeɛ, ayeforɔkunu no nne nti. Ɛno nti afei na me saa anigyeɛ yi awie pɛyɛ. 30Ɔno deɛ, ɛtwa sɛ ɔkɔ kan sene me, na me deɛ, medi akyire.
31 # Yoh 8.23 Deɛ ɔfiri soro ba no sene nnipa nyinaa. Deɛ ɔfiri fam no firi fam, na ɔfiri fam kasa; deɛ ɔfiri soro ba no sene nnipa nyinaa, 32#Yoh 3.11 na deɛ wahunu na wateɛ no, ɛno ho adanseɛ na ɔdie; nanso obi nnye n’adanseɛ no. 33Deɛ ɔgye n’adanseɛ no asi agyinae sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔnokwafoɔ. 34#Yoh 1.33-34 Na deɛ Onyankopɔn asoma no no ka Nyankopɔn nsɛm; na Onyankopɔn de Honhom ma mmorosoɔ. 35#Yoh 5.20; Mat 11.27 Agya no dɔ Ɔba no, na ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa. 36#Yoh 3.18 Deɛ ɔgye Ɔba no die no wɔ daa nkwa; na deɛ ɔntie Ɔba no deɛ, ɔrenya nkwa, na Nyankopɔn abufuo da ne so.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na onipa bi firi Farisifoɔ mu wɔ hɔ a ne din de Nikodemo a ɔyɛ Yudafoɔ panin bi; ɔno na ɔbaa Yesu nkyɛn anadwo, na ɔbɛsee no sɛ: Rabi, yɛnim sɛ wofiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn na aba sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni; na obi ntumi nyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a woyɛ yi, gye sɛ Onyankopɔn ka ne ho. Yesu bua see no sɛ: Mereka akyerɛ wo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Wɔanwo obi foforɔ a, ɔrentumi nhunu Nyankopɔn ahennie no. Nikodemo see no sɛ: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na onipa a wanyini no, wɔbɛtumi awo no? Ɔbɛtumi akɔ ne na yam bio na wɔawo no anaa? Yesu buaa sɛ: Mereka no nokorɛ mu pefee akyerɛ wo sɛ: Wɔamfiri nsuo ne honhom mu anwo obi a, ɔrentumi nhyɛne Nyankopɔn ahennie mu. Deɛ wɔfiri ɔhonam mu awo no no yɛ ɔhonam; na deɛ wɔfiri Honhom mu awo no no yɛ honhom. Mma no nnyɛ wo nwanwa sɛ meka mekyerɛɛ wo sɛ: Ɛtwa sɛ wɔwo mo foforɔ. Mframa bɔ kɔ faako a ɛpɛ, na wote ne nka, na wonnim faako a ɛfire ne faako a ɛrekorɔ. Saa ara nso na obiara a wɔawo no Honhom mu no teɛ.
Nikodemo bua see no sɛ: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yeinom ayɛ hɔ? Yesu bua see no sɛ: Woyɛ Israel kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ na wonnim yeinom? Mereka akyerɛ wo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Deɛ yɛnim na yɛka, na deɛ yɛahunu na yɛdi ho adanseɛ; nanso monnye yɛn adanseɛ no. Sɛ maka mo fam asɛm na monnye nni a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na sɛ meka mo ɔsoro nsɛm a, mobɛgye adie? Na obi mforo nkɔɔ ɔsoro, gye deɛ ɔfiri ɔsoro sianeeɛ no, Onipa Ba a ɔwɔ ɔsoro no. Na sɛdeɛ Mose maa ɔwɔ no so wɔ ɛserɛ soɔ no, saa ara na ɛtwa sɛ wɔma Onipa Ba no soɔ, na obiara a ɔgye no die no anya daa nkwa. Na sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn dɔɔ wiase nie, sɛ ɔde ne Ba a ɔwoo no korɔ no maeɛ, na obiara a ɔgye no die no anyera, na wanya daa nkwa. Na Onyankopɔn ansoma Ɔba no amma wiase sɛ ɔmmɛbu wiase atɛn, na mmom sɛ wɔmfa ne so nnye wiase. Deɛ ɔgye no die no, wɔmmu no atɛn; na deɛ ɔnnye nnie no, wɔabu no atɛn dada sɛ wannye Nyankopɔn ba korɔ no din no annie. Na yei mmom ne atemmuo no, sɛ hann no aba wiase na nnipa dɔ esum sene hann no; ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nnwuma yɛ bɔne. Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no tane hann no, na ɔmma hann no ho, na wɔammu no ne nnwuma ho atɛn. Na deɛ ɔyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ no ba hann no ho sɛ ne nnwuma mmɛda adi, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛɛ no Nyankopɔn mu.

Yeinom akyiri no, Yesu ne n’asuafoɔ no baa Yudea asase so; na ɔne wɔn tenaa hɔ, na ɔbɔɔ asu. Na Yohane nso rebɔ asu wɔ Ainon a ɛbɛn Salim, ɛfiri sɛ asuasu pii wɔ hɔ, na wɔbaa hɔ ma wɔbɔɔ wɔn asu. Na wɔnnya mfaa Yohane ntoo afiase. Ɛnna ahodwira ho akyinnyegyeɛ bi sɔree Yohane asuafoɔ ne Yudafoɔ ntam. Na wɔbaa Yohane nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Rabi, deɛ ɔbaa wo nkyɛn Yordan agya nohoa a wodii ne ho adanseɛ no, hwɛ, ɔno nso rebɔ asu, na nnipa nyinaa rekɔ ne nkyɛn. Yohane bua kaa sɛ: Onipa ntumi nnya biribi, gye sɛ wɔde firi soro ama no ansa. Mo ara modi me adanseɛ sɛ mekaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mene Kristo no, na wɔsomaa me dii n’anim. Deɛ ayeforɔ wɔ no ne ayeforɔkunu; na ayeforɔkunu adamfo a ɔgyina hɔ na ɔtie no deɛ, ɛgyeɛ na n’ani gyeɛ, ayeforɔkunu no nne nti. Ɛno nti afei na me saa anigyeɛ yi awie pɛyɛ. Ɔno deɛ, ɛtwa sɛ ɔkɔ kan sene me, na me deɛ, medi akyire.
Deɛ ɔfiri soro ba no sene nnipa nyinaa. Deɛ ɔfiri fam no firi fam, na ɔfiri fam kasa; deɛ ɔfiri soro ba no sene nnipa nyinaa, na deɛ wahunu na wateɛ no, ɛno ho adanseɛ na ɔdie; nanso obi nnye n’adanseɛ no. Deɛ ɔgye n’adanseɛ no asi agyinae sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ ɔnokwafoɔ. Na deɛ Onyankopɔn asoma no no ka Nyankopɔn nsɛm; na Onyankopɔn de Honhom ma mmorosoɔ. Agya no dɔ Ɔba no, na ɔde nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa. Deɛ ɔgye Ɔba no die no wɔ daa nkwa; na deɛ ɔntie Ɔba no deɛ, ɔrenya nkwa, na Nyankopɔn abufuo da ne so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
